Qaaf. Quran-e-Majeed ki qasam
Lekin in kuffaar ko ta'ajjub hai ke unhi mein se koi shakhs paighambar ban kar aa gaya, is liye un ka kehna yeh hai ke yeh baat bilkul ajeeb hai
Kya jab hum mar kar khaak ho jaayenge to dobaara waapas honge? Yeh badi ba'eed baat hai
Hum jaante hain ke zameen un ke jismon mein se kis qadar kam kar deti hai, aur hamaare paas ek mahfooz kitaab maujood hai
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke un logon ne haq ke aane ke baad us ka inkaar kar diya hai, to woh ek bechaini ki baat mein mubtala hain
Kya un logon ne apne oopar aasmaan ki taraf nahin dekha hai ke hum ne use kis tarah banaaya hai aur phir aaraasta bhi kar diya hai, aur us mein kahin shigaaf bhi nahin hai
Aur zameen ko farsh kar diya hai aur us mein pahaad daal diye hain, aur har tarah ki khoobsoorat cheezein uga di hain
Yeh Khuda ki taraf rujoo karne waale har bande ke liye saamaan-e-naseehat aur wajh-e-baseerat hai
Aur hum ne aasmaan se ba-barakat paani naazil kiya hai, phir us se baaghaat aur khaiti ka ghalla ugaaya hai
Aur lambi lambi khajoorein ugaayi hain jin ke baur aapas mein gutthe hue hain
Yeh sab hamaare bandon ke liye rizq ka saamaan hai, aur hum ne isi paani se murda zameenon ko zinda kiya hai, aur isi tarah tumhein bhi zameen se nikaalenge
In se pehle qaum-e-Nooh, Ashaab-ur-Rass aur Samood ne bhi takzeeb ki thi
Aur qaum-e-Aad, Fir'aun aur biraadaraan-e-Loot ne bhi
Aur Ashaab-ul-Aika aur qaum-e-Tubba' ne bhi, aur in sab ne rasoolon ki takzeeb ki to hamaara waada poora ho gaya
To kya hum pehli khilqat se aajiz the? Hargiz nahin. To phir haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh log nayi khilqat ki taraf se shubhe mein pade hue hain
Aur hum ne hi insaan ko paida kiya hai, aur humein maaloom hai ke us ka nafs kya kya waswase paida karta hai, aur hum us se rag-e-gardan se zyaada qareeb hain
Jab ke do likhne waale us ki harkaton ko likh lete hain jo daahine aur baayein baithe hue hain
Woh koi baat munh se nahin nikaalta hai magar yeh ke ek nigehbaan us ke paas maujood rehta hai
Aur maut ki behoshi yaqeenan taari hogi ke yahi woh baat hai jis se tu bhaaga karta tha
Aur phir Soor phoonka jaaega ke yeh azaab ke waade ka din hai
Aur har nafs ko is andaaz se aana hoga ke us ke saath hankaane waale aur gawaahi dene waale farishte bhi honge
Yaqeenan tum is ki taraf se ghaflat mein the, to hum ne tumhaare pardon ko utha diya hai aur ab tumhaari nigaah bahut tez ho gayi hai
Aur us ka saathi farishta kahega ke yeh us ka amal mere paas tayyaar maujood hai
Hukm hoga ke tum dono har naashukre sarkash ko Jahannam mein daal do
Jo khair se rokne waala, hadd se tajaawuz karne waala aur shubhaat paida karne waala tha
Jis ne Allah ke saath doosre khuda bana diye the, tum dono us ko shadeed azaab mein daal do
Phir us ka saathi Shaitaan kahega ke Khudaaya! Main ne us ko gumraah nahin kiya hai, yeh khud hi gumraahi mein bahut door tak chala gaya tha
Irshaad hoga ke mere paas jhagda mat karo, main pehle hi azaab ki khabar de chuka hoon
Mere paas baat mein tabdeeli nahin hoti hai aur na main bandon par zulm karne waala hoon
Jis din hum Jahannam se kahenge ke kya tu bhar gaya, to woh kahega ke kya kuch aur mil sakta hai
Aur Jannat ko saahibaan-e-taqwa se qareeb-tar kar diya jaaega
Yeh woh jagah hai jis ka waada har Khuda ki taraf rujoo karne waale aur nafs ki hifaazat karne waale se kiya jaata hai
Jo shakhs bhi Rehmaan se pas-e-ghaib darta hai aur us ki baargaah mein rujoo karne waale dil ke saath haazir hota hai
Tum sab salaamati ke saath Jannat mein daakhil ho jaao ke yeh hameshgi ka din hai
Wahaan un ke liye jo kuch bhi chaahenge sab haazir rahega, aur hamaare paas mazeed bhi hai
Aur un se pehle hum ne kitni hi qaumon ko halaak kar diya hai jo un se kahin zyaada taaqatwar thin, to unhon ne tamaam shehron ko chhaan maara tha, lekin maut se chhutkaara kahaan hai
Is waaqe mein naseehat ka saamaan maujood hai us insaan ke liye jis ke paas dil ho, ya jo huzoor-e-qalb ke saath baat sunta ho
Aur hum ne aasmaan o zameen aur un ke darmiyaan ki makhlooqaat ko chhe din mein paida kiya hai, aur humein is silsile mein koi thakan chhoo bhi nahin saki hai
Lihaaza aap un ki baaton par sabr karein aur tuloo-e-aaftaab se pehle aur ghuroob-e-aaftaab se pehle apne Rab ki tasbeeh kiya karein
Aur raat ke ek hisse mein bhi us ki tasbeeh karein aur sajdon ke baad bhi us ki tasbeeh kiya karein
Aur us din ko ghaur se suno jis din qudrat ka munaadi Israafeel qareeb hi ki jagah se aawaaz dega
Jis din sadaa-e-aasmaani ko sab ba-khoobi sun lenge, aur wahi din qabron se nikalne ka din hai
Beshak hum hi maut o hayaat dene waale hain, aur hamaari hi taraf sab ki baazgasht hai
Usi din zameen un logon ki taraf se shaq ho jaaegi aur yeh tezi se nikal khade honge, ke yeh hashr hamaare liye bahut aasaan hai
Humein khoob maaloom hai ke yeh log kya kar rahe hain, aur aap un par jabr karne waale nahin hain. Aap Quran ke zariye un logon ko naseehat karte rahein jo azaab se darne waale hain
